name: Anomalous Railroad Crossing
detailed_description:
"Anomalous Railroad Crossing" is an escape game where you search for strange happenings, set at the most famous railroad crossing in Japan.

Various strange happenings occur, from horrifying, beautiful, and amusing, to large-scale happenings that affect the entire city, so observe carefully and escape from the world invaded by strange happenings.

～

You suddenly realize that you are standing on a road leading to a railroad crossing with a view of the sea.

・First, head towards the railroad crossing.

・Make sure there is no strange happening.

・Make the right choice to escape from the looping world.

--Features of this work--

・This is a sequel to the previous work "Anomalous Crossing - Shibuya -", which was a hot topic in the game commentary community.

・There is no direct connection to the previous work, so it is no problem to start with this work.

・The difficulty level is easy to play.

--How to enjoy--

・This work is an unusual happening game that pays homage to 'Exit 8'.

・Enjoy the eerie and bleak atmosphere around the railroad crossing. This work is influenced by liminal spaces such as 'Backrooms'.

・A wide variety of anomalies will appear, including not only scary ones, but also surprising ones, beautiful ones, ones you've seen somewhere before, funny ones, dangerous ones, and more.

・Even those who are not good at horror can enjoy the content.

--List of Anomalies--

You can check the list of anomalies you have cleared.

Undiscovered anomalies have a higher appearance rate, so please try to find them all.

--Play time--

60 to 120 minutes

It will take longer to find all anomalies-.

--About gameplay video distribution--

You are free to distribute gameplay videos regardless of whether you are an individual or a corporation.

You do not need to contact the developer, but please include a link to the Steam page in the description or somewhere similar.

We are also looking for reviews on Steam to help us continue our development activities. Please feel free to leave a comment.

As with the previous game, we would be happy if many people could play the game.

--Measures against 3D motion sickness--

This is a safe setting that prevents the player's field of vision from shaking up and down even when the player moves. It is relatively easy to play even for those who are prone to motion sickness.

"Center point display" is standard equipment. (A point is displayed in the center of the screen to prevent motion sickness.)
